exposure: Low- and middle-income country (LMIC) of origin
outcome: Heart failure in late pregnancy and postpartum (HFPP)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 241 women diagnosed with heart failure in late pregnancy and postpartum (HFPP) and 1063 age-matched control subjects identified from Swedish national registries between 1997 and 2010.
finding: The mean incidence and mortality among women with HFPP in Sweden from 1997 to 2010 was low but carried a marked excess risk of death compared with control subjects and was strongly linked to preeclampsia, obesity, multifetal births, and LMIC origin of the mother.
